title: .cuevik/lineage.json
description: The project's source-of-truth documents and how they depend on each other. Only direct upstream links are stored; a document's downstream set is every document that reaches it through upstream links.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Increase it when a key is added, removed or renamed.

path.description: Repo-relative path, forward slashes. Unique across documents.

steps.description: cuevik-start steps that write this document, in order.

upstream.description: Paths of the documents this one is written from. Each must be a path in this file; no cycles.

reviewers.description: Roles that must approve a change to the document.

frozen.description: true = no longer updated after initiation (docs/BACKLOG.md: GitHub is the backlog after initiation). Absent = false.
